results.qualification: The cited host merchantfinancing.americanexpress.com no longer resolves (curl: could not resolve host); the Wayback Machine's 2021-22 captures of the URL are redirects to americanexpress.com/us/business/business-funding/merchant-financing/, which by Feb 2022 stated 'American Express is not accepting new customers for Merchant Financing.' The quote and all figures are verbatim in the last full capture (29 Mar 2020): 'Fixed fees range from 1.75-7% (6-Month Term), 3.5-14% (12-Month Term), and 7-28% (24-Month Term).' and 'Early repayment rebates of 25% or 10% of the loan fee'; the page also says 'no interest rate or variable APR'.
results.note: Supported only by a 2020 archive; the product was closed to new customers by 2022 and the cited page is gone, so treat as historical pricing.

Announcement text is embedded in the page's JSON state (React-rendered): 'On October 23, 2026, American Express will publish the American Express Merchant Rules ... consolidate and restate the Merchant Operating Manual - Canada, the Merchant Regulations - International and the Merchant Regulations - U.S. ... the Merchant Rules will become effective on April 24, 2027. Prior to that date, the applicable regional documents referenced above will continue to be effective.' Quote verbatim.

results.qualification: Live URL now 301-redirects to https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/business/business-line-of-credit/ (Business Line of Credit), which contains no Merchant Financing text. The Wayback capture of the cited URL from 22 Jan 2025 supports the substance: 'Simply because your business accepts American Express Cards, you can apply to get a fixed fee business loan between $5,000 and $2,000,000' with repayment 'over 6, 12, or 24 months'. The ledger quote is a search-snippet paraphrase, not verbatim page text.
results.note: Claim substance verified against the Jan 2025 archive; the cited URL has redirected to a different product since about April 2025 per the Wayback CDX index.

results.qualification: The home page is a JS shell; rendered home text (text.js) shows only the 'Get Access ... request keys' step. The quote is verbatim in the portal's JS bundle (/assets/index-CKDoS6PK.js) as a 'Introducing Projects' onboarding tooltip; the bundle also holds the ticket categories 'API Product Information', 'API Access Request', 'API Certificate', 'API Integration' (plus 'Bugs & Technical Issues'), a 'Grant_Type: Client_Credentials' hint, 'HMAC or oAuth 2.0', product types LEGACY_HMAC / NEXTGEN_OAUTH, and the 'amex-signed-certificates' guide with 'American Express Signed Certificate'. I could not locate the phrase 'authorization code' in the bundle, so that grant type is unconfirmed. The a4dextsvr JSON endpoints return 401 without a login.
